text:
Anonymous for another member
Hi Everyone!

I’m Israeli and my husband is American, (we live in a third country currently) and are registered married only in the US. 

We are planing a trip to Israel in September together and I’m worried for some reason they won’t let him in. is any other American- Israeli couple who dealt with any issue entering Israel for a trip? 

Is there any paperwork, or information we need to bring with us to ensure he won’t have an issue when entering for the trip? 

Would love to hear about your experiences! 

he had visited me twice before in Israel, he had been questioned by security before, especially the second time when leaving.

(I escorted him into the baggage line, a mistake btw, do not do that. It led to a interview/interrogation of us and the nature of our relationship by I think ELAL employee who demanded to get my TZ, even though I wasn’t even flying, and I didn’t have it on me)

That’s the main source of my worry, but also a little bit of posts I’ve seen here in the group. 

 Thanks in advance!
